ios.desc:
Buno — Build SwiftUI Apps. No Code. On iPhone.

Create real, native iOS applications entirely on your iPhone. No Mac, no Xcode, no coding — just build.

## Visual UI Builder

Design with 70+ native SwiftUI components: layouts (VStack, HStack, Grid, ScrollView, Form, List), inputs (Slider, Picker, ColorPicker, DatePicker, Toggle), media (Video Player, Audio Player, WebView, QR Code, Charts), navigation (NavigationStack, TabView, Sheets, Menus), data (FilePicker, PhotosPicker, SQLite), and logic blocks (ForEach, If). Polish every detail with 248+ modifiers — fonts, shadows, animations, gestures, sheets, toolbars, haptics — all configured visually.

## Visual Programming — Real Logic

Build real program logic by connecting outputs to inputs visually. 100+ built-in actions: HTTP requests, WebSocket, SQLite database, audio playback, biometric authentication (Face ID / Touch ID), file system, clipboard, calendar, SMS, email, JSON, regex, Base64, cryptography, timers, conditional branching, and loops. No syntax, no errors — just wire it up.

## Instant Run, Native Performance

Tap Run and your app launches immediately — zero compilation. Buno interprets your component tree directly with 60fps native SwiftUI performance.

## iCloud Sync, Every Device

Your projects sync seamlessly across all devices via iCloud. Start on iPhone, continue on iPad.

## For Learners, Prototypers, and Makers

Understand programming concepts visually. Validate app ideas in minutes. Build real tools you use every day.

All processing is on-device. Your data stays private.

Email: hi@shu.dev
